skill.name: unslop
skill.description: Audit and refine existing interfaces in React, Tailwind, HTML, or CSS. Improve spacing, color, typography, and other details while preserving product features and section order.
skill.summary: Review and refine an existing interface with a design direction based on the product.
skill.author: heydamir

security_audit.summary: Most flags matched design prose, template strings, or regular expressions. Confirmed risks include workspace dependency loading, browser executable overrides, unsafe story labels, broad local file serving, and unintended overwrites. No evidence of screenshot uploads or embedded prompt injection was found, but snapshots may retain sensitive or active content.

remediation.issue: Capture can retain sensitive data and load unapproved resources.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the capture target, scope, and destination first. Run in an isolated browser with restricted network access. Review or redact both output files before sharing.

remediation.issue: Saved snapshot HTML can contain active markup.
remediation.suggestion: Sanitize the export with a maintained HTML sanitizer. Remove active elements, event handlers, and unapproved URLs. Offer a screenshot-only mode for untrusted pages.

remediation.issue: Renderer code and executables can come from untrusted workspace or environment settings.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve pinned Playwright packages and the browser from a trusted installation outside the workspace. Remove the environment override or require an explicitly approved executable path.

remediation.issue: The story page can inject label markup into the stage.
remediation.suggestion: Build overlay elements with DOM APIs and set label text with textContent. Render only trusted story HTML in an isolated browser context.

remediation.issue: The story server exposes files beyond the assets needed for rendering.
remediation.suggestion: Serve only the story and approved assets from a dedicated directory. Reject hidden files, require regular files, and handle request and read errors.

remediation.issue: Capture or rendering can overwrite files or delete existing frame data.
remediation.suggestion: Create a unique temporary frame directory and clean up only that directory. Refuse to overwrite existing artifacts unless the user explicitly opts in.

content.user_title: Refine Existing Interfaces With a Design Audit
content.value_statement: Inconsistent spacing, visual effects, and generic copy can make a useful interface harder to read. Unslop diagnoses those issues and proposes a design direction before changing the interface.
actual_capabilities: List visual and copy issues by location, then propose a design direction based on the product and its users.
Apply targeted fixes or work through nine passes covering spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals, and motion.
Review right-to-left layouts for direction, mirrored icons, mixed text, number formatting, and typography.
Recreate a screen from a screenshot or save local HTML and a browser screenshot from an approved page.
Design a product preview or prepare a hero image prompt, with generation available only when an image tool is present.
Render a short local MP4 from a prepared story page with animated changes and optional measurement overlays.
limitations: A screenshot or URL does not provide the original application code. The resulting HTML is a separate deliverable.
A saved snapshot can miss script-driven visuals and may retain active content or remote references. Review it before opening or sharing it.
Browser capture needs Playwright and Chromium. MP4 rendering also needs FFmpeg, and image generation needs a separate tool.
The design checklist does not replace a full accessibility audit or verify product claims.

prompt_templates.title: Identify interface issues
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this screenshot and list the three clearest issues with spacing, contrast, or copy. Name each affected area and suggest one fix. Do not edit anything.

prompt_templates.title: Make targeted dashboard fixes
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the sidebar and table in this React dashboard. Preserve the colors, layout, and behavior. Propose specific spacing and focus changes, then wait for approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused polish in an existing project

prompt_templates.title: Refine a right-to-left screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Arabic billing screen for logical spacing, mirrored icons, and mixed-direction amounts. Propose a design direction and a consistent number format before editing.

prompt_templates.title: Document a full redesign
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this local landing page and propose a design direction before editing. Keep its sections and verified claims. After approval, apply all nine passes and create an MP4 using sanitized local HTML in an isolated folder.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced redesign with a local before-and-after video

output_examples.input: Review the spacing and table hierarchy in a subscription dashboard.
output: Use 36 pixel navigation rows with a 4 pixel gap. Align icons and labels across groups.
Align amounts to the right and use tabular figures. Use separate styles for selected rows and keyboard focus.

output_examples.input: Suggest Arabic layout fixes for a billing screen that includes invoice numbers in Latin script.
output: Move the sidebar to the right and mirror the back arrow. Leave the search icon unchanged.
Keep invoice identifiers in left-to-right order inside Arabic labels. Use one digit system for amounts.

output_examples.input: Propose a landing page visual for an appointment scheduling app.
output_examples.output: Replace the decorative shapes with a preview of the appointment calendar and its available time slots. Keep the booking action prominent.

best_practices: Provide an existing screen and name the product features, brand details, and claims that must stay.
Approve the proposed direction before the full redesign, then compare the rendered result with the original.
Use authorized input and clean output directories. Remove sensitive data and review HTML or video before sharing.
anti_patterns: Replace the existing brand or change the order of sections without approval.
Add unsupported product features, claims, or metrics to improve the presentation.
Capture sensitive pages or render untrusted HTML in a workspace that contains private files.

faq.question: What kinds of screens can I use?
faq.answer: The workflow covers dashboards, application screens, and landing pages. It can start from project files, a URL, or a screenshot.

faq.question: Does it change product functionality?
faq.answer: The default is to preserve product features, content, and section order. It can refine wording and replace placeholder content.

faq.question: Can I request small fixes only?
faq.answer: Yes. The polish workflow addresses the issues found in the audit without replacing the existing palette, layout, typography, or visual.

faq.question: Can it improve a right-to-left interface?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes specific guidance for Arabic, Persian, Urdu, and Hebrew layouts, including mixed text direction and number formatting.

faq.question: Do I need an image generation tool?
faq.answer: No. Without one, the skill can propose an image prompt or build a product preview from the interface.

faq.question: Does the snapshot tool upload screenshots?
faq.answer: No upload was found in the snapshot script. It saves HTML and a PNG locally, but loading the page can contact remote resources.
